changes: Set bonuses are read per tier and apply once you wear enough pieces. Set text copied onto each piece no longer counts on its own.
Church Faithful's +15% healing is now tied to the healing skills it raises.
Off-hand weapon effects apply in full unless the line says main hand only or halved off-hand.
Added Bare Fists (10 Power, 105 Accuracy, 5% at 110%, 100% STR, Blunt), the Unstable Tendril, and Hidden Blade (Slash) and Hidden Barrage as Sword and Gun types.
Empty Palm now applies only to the unarmed weapon, and on its own.
"+N Critical Damage" is flat damage on a crit, and "+N% Critical Damage" raises the crit modifier. Guillotine and Morimayer were giving Critical.
"+N Power to X Weapons (Basic attacks only)" applies only to basic attacks with that weapon type. Ring of Thorns and Archery Gloves were applying to everything.
Spells carry their school, and "+N% Power to X Spells" and "+N Power to X Spells" apply to it. The flat ones were giving weapon Power.
Read on-hit damage from about 40 weapons and gloves, such as Icebreaker's 50% Ice ATK and Burning Bracers' 15 Fire.
Read race, boss and torso bonuses: Mythslayer, Giant Slayer, Kingslayer, the armor Slayers, the Foe Shields, Jammer Waders and Sharkfang Necklace.
Read +5% Critical Chance, percent Max HP, Darkness ATK and "Armor & Magic Armor", which were missed before.
Arcane Tattoo (Fist) only makes the unarmed weapon Magical.
Item switches and rolls are keyed by their text, so wiki edits don't shift them onto other lines.
